install:
set -euo pipefail
sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true
grep -qxF 'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
grep -qxF 'export CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=line-tables-only' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=line-tables-only' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
export CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=line-tables-only
pkgs=(libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libappindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev libdbus-1-dev patchelf libxkbcommon-dev libwayland-dev mesa-vulkan-drivers libxkbcommon-x11-0 xvfb)
missing=0
for pkg in "${pkgs[@]}"; do
  dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}' "$pkg" 2>/dev/null | grep -qx 'install ok installed' || { missing=1; break; }
done
if [ "$missing" -eq 1 ]; then
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "${pkgs[@]}"
fi
bun_ver="$(jq -r '.packageManager // "bun@1.3.1" | sub("^bun@"; "")' package.json)"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.bun/bin"
if [ ! -x "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" ] || [ "$("$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" --version 2>/dev/null || true)" != "$bun_ver" ]; then
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) bun_plat="linux-x64" ;;
    aarch64|arm64) bun_plat="linux-aarch64" ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported arch: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
  curl -fsSL "https://registry.npmjs.org/@oven/bun-${bun_plat}/-/bun-${bun_plat}-${bun_ver}.tgz" -o "$tmp_dir/bun.tgz"
  tar -xzf "$tmp_dir/bun.tgz" -C "$tmp_dir" package/bin/bun
  install -m 0755 "$tmp_dir/package/bin/bun" "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun"
  ln -sfn bun "$HOME/.bun/bin/bunx"
  rm -rf "$tmp_dir"
fi
rustup target list --installed | grep -qx 'wasm32-unknown-unknown' || rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
bun install --frozen-lockfile
bun -e "import { canaryBun } from './scripts/test.ts'; await canaryBun()"
bun scripts/canvas/check-figcraft-pin.mjs
if [ ! -s canvas/bundle/index.html ] || ! cmp -s canvas/figcraft.pin canvas/bundle/.figcraft.pin; then
  bun scripts/canvas/fetch-figcraft-bundle.mjs
  cp canvas/figcraft.pin canvas/bundle/.figcraft.pin
fi
[ -s dist-web/index.html ] || bun run build:web
